parent.prior: WSP96 randomized intervention numerical/symbolic/trained controls all tie at 380/400; passive confounded 164/400; hidden 25%-minority XOR and fixed planner; development only, not scientific superiority.

hypothesis: When two structural causal models generate IDENTICAL original passive observations but DIFFERENT distributions under do(action), a directly edited numerical two-hypothesis evidence weight can use three strategically chosen real interventions to identify the regime and predict action outcomes in UNPROBED contexts. Independent symbolic Bayesian and conventional gradient-trained tabular+likelihood controls receive the same data and are expected to tie. Active intervention selection, rather than the direct writing rule, should outperform uninformed random selection within the same 3-probe budget.

world.unobserved_common_cause: An unobserved binary U controls passive action selection A=U, and in the hidden_proxy model also directly controls outcome Y. In action_causal model Y=f(context,setting,A); in hidden_proxy Y=f(context,setting,U). Thus the same passive observational data (A=U, Y=f(context,setting,A)) is EXACTLY identical across both causal regimes, but do(A=a) distinguishes them.
world.unknown_function: For each context, frozen original hash-seeded hidden phase bit, hidden constant bit and hidden informative setting (0 or 1). If setting==informative, f(c,setting,x)=x XOR phase(c); otherwise f(c,setting,x)=constant(c). Source context phases and informative-setting choices are NOT given to models, but exact passive observations reveal all four table cells per context.
world.passive_sampling: Exactly one observational record per (context c=0..7,setting=0/1,observed_action=0/1) generated by structurally setting hidden U=A; Y=f(c,b,U) in proxy and f(c,b,A) in causal. This stratified observational set ensures ALL truth-table cells are observed, yet cannot identify which causal mechanism is correct. Passive rows with U are NEVER passed to any learner; paired regimes MUST have byte-identical passive source. Stratification is a controlled synthetic sampling scheme, not a claim of a natural observational population distribution.
world.do_source: For each query, simulator sets action A independently of private U drawn Bernoulli(0.20); causal world output f(c,b,A), hidden_proxy world output f(c,b,U); observed output then bit flipped with probability 0.02. Candidate/control see only {context_id,setting,action,observed_y,probe_index} without U, regime, true f or other world's source. Potential U+measurement-noise keyed solely by pair seed, intervention index and query parameters; identical across active/random policy for same prospective action.
world.active_policy: After fitting the 32 passive cells, search only two permitted intervention contexts c in {0,1}, setting b in {0,1}, action a in {0,1}; rank choices by |f(c,b,a)-[0.8*f(c,b,0)+0.2*f(c,b,1)]| as predicted from passive learned cells; choose highest, tiebreak c/setting/action and alternate the two contexts for three trials to avoid single-context dependence. This policy must not access hidden regime, U, test contexts or simulator private map.
world.random_policy: Choose independently uniform (context 0/1, setting 0/1, action 0/1) with frozen SHA256 seeds per pair+trial, identical policy query sequence for paired regimes and exactly 3 probes. Common potential outcomes when the action/query matches active source.
world.evaluation: After all three DO outcomes and all model predictions are frozen, evaluate 24 interventional majority/expected-output requests per world: every (context c=2..7,setting b=0/1,action a=0/1). No DO probe is ever allowed in these six held-out contexts. The true requested outcome is the MODAL potential-outcome bit: action_causal f(c,b,a); hidden_proxy f(c,b,0), since U=1 only 20% and measurement flip 2%. Unseen contexts' PASSIVE f tables ARE available to every model, so this tests GENERALIZATION OF THE SHARED CAUSAL REGIME after do-probing, not zero-information world generalization.
world.diagnostic_eval: Of the 24 requests per world, only six (for each held-out context, action=1, informative setting) DIFFER between the observationally indistinguishable causal hypotheses. The primary metric is exact accuracy on those 6 diagnostic outcomes, plus report full 24 accuracy and source fit. If a model guesses wrong regime all 6 diagnostic requests fail, even though non-diagnostic requests still match.
world.source_nonidentifiability: The two paired regimes' entire 32-row passive record bytes and SHA256 MUST be identical; their true interventional majority predictions must disagree on exactly six held-out diagnostic requests per world. This is an independent negative control on observational identifiability.
world.first_use: Only original public pair seeds initially; do not instantiate any reserved world pair 97101..97120 before exact-source final qualification. Public/reserved seeds and generator are visible; DEV first-use is not protected independently sealed SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

candidate.representation: Finite directly written per-context/setting/action bit table from 32 original passive observations, and ONE directly edited numeric hypothesis log-likelihood-ratio weight for causal vs hidden_proxy, initially 0, updated by the three actual do outcomes. No gradient in candidate, transformer, next-token architecture or word-level tokenization.
candidate.learning: Use observed passive cell values only. Under each DO source row, compute model-predicted P(y|action_causal) and P(y|hidden_proxy) from fitted passive table, frozen U marginal 0.20 and measurement flip 0.02. Directly add log(P(y|causal)/P(y|proxy)) to the numeric hypothesis weight. Decide causal if posterior log odds >=0, else proxy. No regime label is supplied. The likelihood update is a deliberately preprogrammed Bayesian rule, NOT an autonomously invented causal rule.
candidate.inference: Given new {context,setting,action}, read the previously learned passive function and apply either f(c,b,action) when causal or f(c,b,0) when proxy. Predict only categorical majority bit, never hidden U or specific noisy future single-outcome.
candidate.memory: Checksum-signed passive bit table, source count, observation source identities and posterior weight; exact cold restore after learning independent world B, corruption rejection, unknown/unobserved contexts abstain, replayed do trial rejection; no replay of consumed first-use.

strong_controls.independent_symbolic: Independent source truth-table dictionary and analytic Bayes log-likelihood update from the EXACT same active 3 do rows; predict held-out contexts. Exact tie expected, reported as no advantage.
strong_controls.fully_trained_conventional: Ordinary gradient-trained 32-cell one-hot sigmoid likelihood predictor fitted for 500 deterministic epochs on identical original passive rows (require 32/32 source fit), followed by ordinary exact two-regime Bayesian model comparison using its trained truth-table predictions and the EXACT same 3 active randomized DO rows. This comparator is a fully trained conventional tabular reader, not a state-of-the-art pretrained world model. It may tie or outperform candidate; tie proves no weight-edit superiority.
strong_controls.random_probe_numeric: Same direct evidence rule and passive table, three RANDOM do queries, common potential U/noise; same total intervention budget. Compare active policy to random with paired original worlds.
strong_controls.passive_only_causal_assumption: Same passive data, no do experiments, always assumes action_causal; exactly 50% of paired regimes identifiable, a non-intervention negative not a matched-information control.
strong_controls.shuffled_do_effect: Negative: same original 3 do observations but swap observed output bits (or permute source context bindings) before updating candidate; report source and effect ablation, never treat as conventional baseline.
strong_controls.oracle: Evaluator-only true hidden regime and passive function, 24/24 per world, never passed to models. No model receives true regime or U.

frozen.independent_science: UNVERIFIED; this is synthetic causal regime discrimination with preprogrammed Bayesian hypothesis models, same-information symbolic/conventional expected to tie. It is not spontaneous discovery of new algorithms, true general language understanding, or AGI.

procedure: First commit contains ONLY this preregistration before all WSP97 code and source first use.

Use 12 previously untouched public causal pair seeds; verify exact passive-source SHA equality for each causal/proxy twin, strong trained source fit and hidden do predictions that diverge; run both Ubuntu and Windows exact same source.
If public fails ANY frozen criterion, mark scientific negative, do not retune based on public results or open reserved DEV; seal negative in GitHub.
On positive, verify real original CI run SHA/Windows/Ubuntu jobs and create source-controlled positive receipt; G29 source-only atlas companion must change exactly 3 generated .ice files.
Mandatory exact-source full focused WSP80..WSP97 and complete root Yggdrasil regression on Ubuntu and Windows; only one admitted reserved original run attempt 1 after both platform PASS.
Record all results/metrics in GitHub PR, never upload user Library artifacts, never merge/promote/integrate Yggdrasil or FORGE official loops or create any scheduler.
